Common Questions

Quick answers before you reach out.

Can I get a refund if I cancel mid-month?

PocketRoute subscriptions are billed monthly and are not prorated on cancellation — you retain access until the end of your billing period. Annual plan refunds are handled case-by-case. Email billing@pocketroute.io with your request.

How do I transfer my account to a new owner?

Account ownership transfers require verification from both parties. Email support@pocketroute.io with the subject line "Account Transfer Request" and include your account email and the new owner's email. We typically complete transfers within 1 business day.

Can I pause my subscription instead of canceling?

Yes — Growth and Team plans can pause billing for up to 3 months per year. Your data and team settings are preserved. Go to Settings → Billing → Pause Subscription, or email us if you don't see the option.

Do you offer discounts for non-profits or educational organizations?

Yes. We offer 30% off Growth and Team plans for registered 501(c)(3) organizations and accredited educational institutions. Email support@pocketroute.io with proof of status and we'll apply the discount to your next billing cycle.

Is PocketRoute HIPAA or SOC 2 compliant?

PocketRoute is SOC 2 Type II certified (report available upon request under NDA). We do not currently hold HIPAA certification, as delivery route data does not typically constitute protected health information. Contact enterprise@pocketroute.io for compliance documentation.

Faster resolution

When contacting support, always include your account email, the Route ID (if relevant), the driver's email (if driver-related), and any error messages or screenshots. This helps us skip the back-and-forth and get to the root cause faster.
